HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   C. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat National Security as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   B. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

9. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   C. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

11. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict, Transformation and Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Digital divide and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Inclusivity and Interdependence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
